armySpecialRules.name: Beneath Contempt
armySpecialRules.description:
Gnoblars have the Expendable special rule. In addition,
even other Gnoblars treat them as being Expendable.

armySpecialRules.name: Bicker
armySpecialRules.description:
Roll a D6 at the beginning of each of your turns for
each unit with this special rule that is not in combat or
fleeing and has a Unit Strength of 5 or more. If a unit
rolls a 1 it may not move in the Movement phase or
shoot in the Shooting phase this turn.

armySpecialRules.name: Ogre Charge
armySpecialRules.description:
Each model on foot with the Ogre Charge special rule
that successfully charges an enemy has the Impact Hits
(1) special rule. In addition, they add their current Rank
Bonus to the Strength of the Impact Hits they inflict. In
addition, they count as having one more rank than their
actual number for the purpose of determining Steadfast
in any turn that they charge.

armySpecialRules.name: Blood Vulture
armySpecialRules.description:
A blood vulture is treated as a missile weapon with the
following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
24" 4 Sniper
Rather than rolling to Hit using Ballistic Skill, the
target must pass a Weapon Skill test to avoid being Hit.

armySpecialRules.name: Chaintrap
armySpecialRules.description:
A chaintrap has the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
6/9" 6 Killing Blow,
Quick Shot

armySpecialRules.name: Gut-Plate
armySpecialRules.description:
A model with a gut-plate gains a 6+ armour save
against attacks to the front.

armySpecialRules.name: Impale
armySpecialRules.description:
A mount with this special rule has the Mighty Blow (1)
special rule in any turn that it charges.

armySpecialRules.name: Ironfist
armySpecialRules.description:
Buckler. If a model with an ironfist rolls a natural 6
when making a Parry save, it automatically inflicts an
extra Hit back onto the model or unit that struck the
blow.

armySpecialRules.name: Harpoon Launcher
armySpecialRules.description:
A harpoon launcher has the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
28/42" 5 Multiple Wounds (D3),
Ponderous

armySpecialRules.name: Ogre Pistol
armySpecialRules.description:
Ogre pistols have the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
12/24" 5 Multiple Shots (2)*,
Quick Shot
*Requires a brace of Ogre pistols.

armySpecialRules.name: Oriental Longsword
armySpecialRules.description:
Oriental longswords have the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
Combat As user Parry (6+)
An Oriental Longsword gives the wielder +1 To
Wound.

armySpecialRules.name: Luck-Gnoblar
armySpecialRules.description:
One use only. An Ogre with a Luck-Gnoblar may re-
roll a single armour or invulnerable save, once per
battle.

armySpecialRules.name: Sword-Gnoblar
armySpecialRules.description:
An Ogre with a Sword-Gnoblar benefits from one extra
Attack with Weapon Skill 2, Strength 2 and Initiative 2.

armySpecialRules.name: Tooth-Gnoblar
armySpecialRules.description:
One use only. After attempting to cast a spell from the
Lore of the Great Maw, a Butcher with a Tooth-
Gnoblar may choose to sacrifice one to get +1 to his
casting value.

armySpecialRules.name: Look-Out Gnoblar
armySpecialRules.description:
Any character in a unit with a Look-out Gnoblar
benefits from the 'Look Out Sir!' special rule as long as
there are three rank and file models of the same troop
type remaining in the unit.

armySpecialRules.name: Name-Gnoblar
armySpecialRules.description:
For each Name-Gnoblar an Ogre has, he can choose an
additional Big Name.

armySpecialRules.name: Scalp-Gnoblar
armySpecialRules.description:
One use only. A Butcher with a Scalp-Gnoblar may re-
roll a single dice when attempting to cast a spell from
the Lore of the Great Maw.

magicItems.name: Frostfang
magicItems.description:
The bearer gains the Ice Attacks special rule. In
addition, at the start of each round of close combat, roll
a D6. On a 4+, all attacks made by this weapon are
increased by +1 Strength for the duration of the game.
This effect is cumulative.

magicItems.name: Thundermace
magicItems.description:
Great weapon. The wielder may choose to exchange all
of his Attacks in close combat to make a single
'Thundercrush Attack'. Roll To Hit against the highest
Weapon Skill amongst the enemy models in base
contact. If the Thundercrush Attack hits, place the
small template anywhere so that it is touching the
wielder's base. Any infantry, war beasts or swarm
models that lie underneath the template suffer a single
Strength 3 hit. The model under the template's central
hole instead suffers a single Strength 9 hit with the
Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule. This has no effect
on other troop types.

magicItems.name: Siegebreaker
magicItems.description:
Great weapon. Roll To Hit against the enemy's
Initiative instead of his Weapon Skill, and no Parry
saves are allowed - it is impossible to deflect a blow
from the weapon. In addition, when assaulting models
in a building, the wielder can make a 'Siegebreaker
Attack' instead of attacking normally in the Close
Combat phase. A Siegebreaker Attack inflicts D6 hits
with a Strength equal to the height of the building in
inches, up to a maximum Strength of 10 (so, for
example, models in a building that is 6 inches high
would suffer D6 Strength 6 hits). Measure from the
base of the building to its highest point.
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the Ogres.
in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: The Tenderiser
magicItems.description:
Great weapon. The Tenderiser gives the wielder the
Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: Bloodcleaver
magicItems.description:
Butcher or Slaughtermaster only. Every time the
wielder causes an unsaved wound with the
Bloodcleaver, he may regain one wound he lost earlier
in the battle.

magicItems.name: The Fang Of Ghur
magicItems.description:
The wielder of this weapon gains the Frenzy special
rule. In addition, no Magical Ward saves can be taken
against it.

magicItems.name: Frostshard Javelins
magicItems.description:
Hunter only. Javelins. Attacks made with this weapon
have the Ice Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: Sky-Titan Scatter Pistols
magicItems.description:
Brace of Ogre Pistols. These weapons have the
following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
9/18" 5 Armour Piercing (1),
Multiple Shots (2D3),
Quick Shot

magicItems.name: Bellowing Blade
magicItems.description:
The wielder of this weapon may re-roll one failed To
Hit or To Wound roll each round of close combat for
every enemy Character within 12".

magicItems.name: Blade Of All-Frost
magicItems.description:
For every successful Wound this weapon inflicts on an
enemy Character, Monstrous Creature or Monster, that
model suffers -1 Strength and Toughness for the
remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: Headsmasher
magicItems.description:
Great weapon. Headsmasher gives the wielder the
Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: Splatter-Cleaver
magicItems.description:
Butcher or Slaughtermaster only. Every time the
wielder causes an unsaved wound with the Splatter-
cleaver, they gain +1 Leadership for the duration of the
close combat round.

magicItems.name: Greedy Fist
magicItems.description:
Ironfist. The wearer gains +1 Strength and a Magical
Ward (6+). If a Magic Weapon inflicts a Wound that is
saved by the model's Parry save, it is then treated as a
normal, non-magical weapon of the same type for the
remainder of the game. In addition, an enemy Wizard
loses a Wizard level and a randomly selected spell each
time they suffer an unsaved Wound by an Ogre wearing
the Greedy Fist.

magicItems.name: Mastodon Armour
magicItems.description:
Light armour. If the wearer is killed by an attack that is
not made in close combat, roll a D6; on a 2+, they will
remain in play with one Wound remaining.

magicItems.name: Gut Maw
magicItems.description:
Gut-plate. An Ogre wearing the Gut Maw has the
Terror special rule. In addition, he recovers one lost
Wound (up to his starting number) for each unsaved
Wound he causes in a challenge.
BULLGUT* 15 points
Model on foot only. Gut-plate. The Bullgut gives the
wearer the Impact Hits (D3) special rule, and all Impact
Hits have the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.
KATTANAK BROWPLATE* 15 points
Gut-plate. The wearer gains +1 Leadership. In addition,
all War Beasts and Monstrous Beasts suffer -1 To Hit
against him.
magicItems.restriction:
Gut-plate. An Ogre wearing the Gut Maw has the
Terror special rule. In addition, he recovers one lost
Wound (up to his starting number) for each unsaved
Wound he causes in a challenge.
BULLGUT* 15 points
Model on foot only.

magicItems.name: Greatskull
magicItems.description:
Gut-plate. Any Wizard that targets the bearer with a
spell will miscast on any roll of any double.

magicItems.name: Grawl'S Gut-Plate
magicItems.description:
Gut-plate. The bearer of this item and any unit they are
with adds +D3" to their charge distance while within
18" of any enemy unit.
ICE MAMMOTH SKULL PLATE* 10 points
Gut-plate. The wearer may re-roll failed armour saves.

magicItems.name: Skullplucker
magicItems.description:
Ironfist. Any hits made with the Skullplucker have the
Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: Gnoblar Thiefstone
magicItems.description:
A Gnoblar Thiefstone grants the bearer Magic
Resistance (1). In addition, roll on the following table
when the model is deployed to see if the Thiefstone has
helped them to 'find' any useful items. Note that this
may result in the bearer of the Thiefstone having two or
more Talismans. In addition, if a character is killed in
close combat while being in base contact with the
model wearing the Thiefstone, you will automatically
be allowed to pick up any one Magic Item (except
Magic Standards) that the slain character might have
had, as long as the bearer does not already have a
magic item of that type. The model with the Thiefstone
may then use that item itself for the rest of the battle.
D6 Result
1 Nothing
2 Lucky Trinket
3 Talisman of Protection
4 Crown of Command
5 The Ruby Ring of Ruin
6 Talisman of Preservation

magicItems.name: Greyback Pelt
magicItems.description:
Hunter only. The Greyback Pelt gives the bearer the
Forest Strider, Hill Strider, Ice Attacks, and Magical
Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: Spangleshard
magicItems.description:
For each Wound the bearer of the Spangleshard suffers,
roll a D6. If this roll is higher than the result of the To
Wound roll, that wound is ignored.

magicItems.name: Cathayan Jet Pendant
magicItems.description:
The bearer of the Cathayan Jet and any unit they join
gains the Magic Resistance (3) special rule. This has no
effect on spells from the Lore of Yin and Yang.

magicItems.name: The Pelt Of Charngar
magicItems.description:
Hunter only. The bearer of this item gains the Natural
Armour (6+) and Regeneration (5+) special rules.

magicItems.name: The Purple Rock
magicItems.description:
Honcho only. This item may be used once in each
enemy Magic phase. When the enemy casts a
successful spell, instead of attempting to dispel it the
bearer may activate the Purple Rock. Roll a D6, on the
result of a 4+ the spell is automatically dispelled. On
the result of a 1-3 the spell goes through as normal and
the bearer of the Purple Rock suffers a Strength 3 hit.

magicItems.name: The Rime Shroud
magicItems.description:
All successful To Hit rolls with missile attacks
targeting the bearer of this item must be re-rolled.

magicItems.name: Red Stone
magicItems.description:
Honcho only. The bearer gains a Magical Ward (6+)
and the Magic Resistance (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: Battered Talisman
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item gains a Magical Ward (4+)
against Attacks with Strength 5 or more.
FUNNY TRINKET* 15 points
Honcho only. The bearer of this item may re-roll failed
armour saves and invulnerable saves.
magicItems.restriction:
The bearer of this item gains a Magical Ward (4+)
against Attacks with Strength 5 or more.
FUNNY TRINKET* 15 points
Honcho only.

magicItems.name: Grubbi'S Dice Bag
magicItems.description:
Honcho only. One use only. When the bearer of this
item suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On a 2+, the Wound is
ignored, as are all subsequent Wounds that turn. On the
result of a 1 the bearer is slain outright regardless of the
number of Wounds inflicted.
SHRUNKEN PRIEST HEAD* 15 points
Butcher or Slaughtermaster only. The bearer of this
item gains a Magical Ward (5+) against the first
wounding Hit each phase.
WYRDSTONE NECKLACE* 15 points
The wearer of the Wyrdstone Necklace gains a Magical
Ward (5+). However, they must pass a Toughness test
at the start of each of their turns or suffer a wound with
no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Hellheart
magicItems.description:
Charm. One Use Only. The Hellheart can be used at the
start of one of the opposing side's Magic phases,
immediately after rolling for the Winds of Magic. All
enemy Wizards within 12" of the bearer must roll 2D6
on the Miscast table. Special rules or magic items that
affect a normal miscast roll can be used against
miscasts caused by the Hellheart. After resolving all the
Miscasts, add an extra dispel dice to the Ogre's dispel
pool for each enemy Wizard that was forced to roll on
the Miscast table.

magicItems.name: Bangstick
magicItems.description:
Relic. Bound Spell (Level 3, cast on 8+). The
Bangstick contains a magic missile with a range of 24"
that causes 2D6 Strength 4 Hits with the Flaming
Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: Grut'S Sickle
magicItems.description:
Relic. At the start of the Ogre Magic phase, the bearer
of Grut's Sickle can inflict a single Wound on any unit
he has joined. If he does so, then he adds +2 to all
casting rolls he makes during that Magic phase. A
Wound inflicted by Grut's Sickle is distributed as a
shooting attack, and may not be saved in any way. Roll
2D6 at the end of each Magic phase where Grut's
Sickle is used; on a roll of 3 or more nothing happens,
but on a roll of double 1 the unit turns upon and slays
the wielder of Grut's Sickle, and he is removed as a
casualty with no saves of any kind allowed.

magicItems.name: The Hungry Maw
magicItems.description:
Charm. One use only. The Hungry Maw can be used
after successfully dispelling an enemy spell. When
used, the enemy caster can no longer use this spell for
the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: Halfling Cookbook
magicItems.description:
Relic. A model with the Halfling Cookbook may re-roll
one dice (except 1's) per casting roll when using the
Lore of the Great Maw.

magicItems.name: Dragon Heart
magicItems.description:
Charm. One use only. This item can be used at the start
of any of your Magic phases. For the duration of this
turn, the bearer may re-roll failed casting attempts.

magicItems.name: Flask Of Congealed Maw-Juices
magicItems.description:
Model with Great Mawpot only. Charm. One use only.
This item can be used at the start of any of your Magic
phases. For the duration of this turn, you may add one
free power dice to each of the model's casting attempts.

magicItems.name: Bloodrock Talisman
magicItems.description:
Relic. The bearer of this item gains a +2 dispel bonus if
they are within 12" of the casting Wizard.

magicItems.name: Wizardflesh Apron
magicItems.description:
Wizard with the Lore of the Great Maw only. Relic. At
the start of each of your Magic phases, the bearer of
this item can pick one additional spell from the Lore of
the Great Maw of those normally available to them and
cast it this turn.
magicItems.restriction: Wizard with the Lore of the Great Maw only.

magicItems.name: Tokens Of The Everwinter
magicItems.description:
One use only. This can be used at the start of any round
of close combat. For the duration of this turn, the
model (but not any mount) gains +1 Strength as well as
the Always Strikes First and Natural Armour (5+)
special rules.

magicItems.name: Brand Of The Svard
magicItems.description:
Mounted model only. The bearer's mount gain +1 To
Hit in close combat.

magicItems.name: The Seat Of Alvagr
magicItems.description:
Mounted model only. The model may make double
their normal amount of Stomps.

magicItems.name: Bleeding Skull Of Dragaar
magicItems.description:
Tyrant, Bruiser or Hunter only. The bearer of this item
can channel dispel dice in the same manner as a Level
2 Wizard.
GNOBLAR BLAST KEG* 20 points
Tyrant or Bruiser only. One use only. This item can be
used during any of your Shooting phases. Place the
small round template anywhere within 6" - it scatters
D3". Any model touched by the template suffers a
Strength 3 Hit with the Armour Piercing (1) special
rule. The model under the hole suffers a Strength 6 Hit
with the Armour Piercing (1) and Multiple Wounds
(D3) special rules.
GRUESOME TROPHY RACK* 20 points
Tyrant only. Any unit joined by this model may re-roll
1's To Hit in close combat.

magicItems.name: Shatterstone
magicItems.description:
All enemy units within 12" of the bearer of this item
treat all terrain features as Dangerous Terrain. Terrain
that is already Dangerous Terrain makes them fail the
test on a 1-2 instead of just a 1.
BRAHMIR STATUE* 15 points
Any Psychology tests caused by the bearer of the
Brahmir Statue (or any unit they are with) on any
Beastmen unit are taken with a -3 Leadership penalty.
ALVAGR RUNE-TOKENS* 15 points
One use only. This item can be used at the start of any
round of close combat. The wielder gains the Ice
Attacks special rule for the duration of this round.
CARVALOX FLANK* 15 points
All friendly units of Yhetees within 12" of the bearer
gain +2 to their Movement.
ELIXIR OF THE FROSTWYRM* 15 points
One use only. The bearer gains a Strength 4 Breath
Weapon attack with the Ice Attacks special rule.
However, after using it they will automatically suffer a
Wound with no saves allowed.
FROST-TALON SHARDBOLTS* 15 points
Hunter with Harpoon Launcher only. All shots fired by
their weapon have the Ice Attacks and Magical Attacks
special rules.
GREASE-SMEARED TUSKS* 15 points
Butcher or Slaughtermaster only. All friendly
Monstrous Beasts, Monstrous Creatures and Monsters
within 12" gain +1 to their Movement.
JADE LION* 15 points
The bearer of the Jade Lion and any unit they are with
may re-roll any failed Psychology tests. If the unit flees
for any reason, this benefit is lost for the remainder of
the game.
BATTLE BREW* 10 points
One use only. The bearer may use this item at the start
of any of your turns. If they do so, they gain +1 To Hit
and To Wound in Close Combat this turn. However, at
the end of that round of close combat (before break
tests are taken), they must pass a Toughness test or
suffer a Wound with no saves allowed.
FLASK OF STONEHORN BLOOD* 10 points
One use only. The bearer may use this item at the start
of any of your turns. If they do so, all attacks targeting
them must re-roll successful rolls To Wound for the
duration of this turn.
OGRE TOOTH* 10 points
Honcho only. One use only. This item may be used at
the start of any of your turns. Roll a D6; on the result
of a 1 the bearer is immediately removed as a casualty.
On the result of a 2+, the character and any Gnoblar
unit within 6" gains the Immunity (Psychology) special
rule until the start of your next turn.
SKULLMANTLE* 10 points
Butcher or Slaughtermaster only. Any enemy unit
forced to take any Leadership tests due to the bearer or
a unit they have joined suffers a -1 penalty to their
Leadership.
FISTFUL OF LAURELS* 5 points
One use only. The model with the Fistful of Laurels
and any unit they are with may re-roll their first failed
Break test in the game using an additional D6 and
discard the highest result.
ROCK EYE* 5 points
At the beginning of each Ogre turn, pick one unit in the
line of sight of the bearer of the Rock Eye. The
opposing player must announce the presence of all
Magic Items, Hidden models and the like that unit
might have.
magicItems.restriction:
All enemy units within 12" of the bearer of this item
treat all terrain features as Dangerous Terrain. Terrain
that is already Dangerous Terrain makes them fail the
test on a 1-2 instead of just a 1.
BRAHMIR STATUE* 15 points
Any Psychology tests caused by the bearer of the
Brahmir Statue (or any unit they are with) on any
Beastmen unit are taken with a -3 Leadership penalty.
ALVAGR RUNE-TOKENS* 15 points
One use only.

magicItems.name: Dragonhide Banner
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard can re-roll all To Hit, To
Wound and saving throw rolls of 1 on the turn they
make a successful charge. In addition, the bearer of the
banner can use it to unleash an icy blast. This is a
Strength 3 Breath Weapon with the Ice Attacks special
rule.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Great Maw
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Killing Blow
special rule.

magicItems.name: Cannibal Totem
magicItems.description:
If the unit carrying this standard is in base contact with
an enemy Troop Type with the same or higher Unit
Strength as them, all models in the unit re-roll failed To
Hit and To Wound rolls in the first round of that
combat. However, they may not Overrun and must
Pursue the enemy if possible.

magicItems.name: Rune Maw
magicItems.description:
When any enemy spell targeting a unit with this
standard is successfully cast, roll a D6. On a roll of 2+,
the caster must choose a new target for the spell. If no
other target is available (because no other target is in
range or all eligible units have already been targeted,
for example), then the spell is wasted but still counts as
having been cast. Spells that do not specifically target
the unit are not affected by the Rune Maw.

magicItems.name: Bull Standard
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard re-rolls failed To Wound
rolls for their Impact Hits.

magicItems.name: Ragbanner
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard has the Cold-blooded
special rule when taking Panic tests.

one lost Wound (up to his starting number of Wounds),
and adds +1 to the total rolled on the dice the next time
he attempts to cast or dispel a spell. On a roll of 1 the
